LightningComponentBundle.description: Lets users upload a CSV list of up to 2,000 Leads. Built for Experience Cloud pages; also works on Lightning app and home pages.

property.name: defaultLeadSource
property.label: Default Lead Source
property.description: Lead Source applied to rows that don't have one, e.g. Partner Referral. Must be a valid Lead Source value. When set, the Lead Source column becomes optional.
